_doc: An example with two made-up character voices (from the project's own videos): a goofy clay golfer and a movie-trailer announcer. Use it with: voice/install.py --script voice/example-voices.json. Voice ids must stay unique; recordings are matched by id and line number.

voices.name: Barnaby

try.text: Barnaby here! Today we're facing a part on the lathe, and I promise not to drop it this time.

voices.direction: Barnaby, the clay golfer who hosts the shop videos and trailers. Make up a voice for him: friendly, a bit goofy, proud of every little thing. An accent is fine, but make it your own, not an impression of someone famous. Keep the same voice for every line.

lines.text: Stay quiet for 3 seconds. This records the room's background sound.
Hi, I'm Barnaby! Welcome back to the shop.
Today we're grinding a tool, and then we're cutting some threads.
Safety glasses on. Always. Even me, and I'm made of clay.
Okay, one light skim pass. Nice and easy.
Whoa, look at that chip curl!
That's five hundred thou. Half an inch. Don't let anybody tell you otherwise.
Measure twice, cut once. Then measure again, just in case.
Hmm, that doesn't look right. Let's back it off a little.
And... there it is. Perfect fit. I'm not crying, you're crying.
Fore! Sorry. Wrong hobby.
A good chamfer is like a good handshake. Firm, but not too firm.
Here's a tip from an old golfer: slow down. The machine isn't going anywhere.
Is this necessary? Absolutely not. Is it awesome? You bet it is.
Thanks, editor. Okay, back to me.
Stick around, because by the end, you'll have one too.
Hole in one! Well, a thread in one. Close enough.
Ready? Three, two, one, cut.
Wait, wait, wait. Did that just work on the first try?
If you've got questions, drop them in the comments. I read every single one.
Who left the zombies in the garage again?
That's a wrap for today. Now go make something!

voices.name: Announcer

try.text: This winter... one game will change everything. Coming soon.

voices.direction: The big movie-trailer voice for game trailers. Slow, deep, dramatic, with long pauses. Have fun with it.

lines.text: Stay quiet for 3 seconds. This records the room's background sound.
In a world... where the zombies never stop coming...
One neighborhood. One night. No way out.
One neighborhood. Play it now, free, in your browser.
This fall... the stakes have never been higher.
Eighteen holes. One golfer. Zero chill.
They said it couldn't be done. They were wrong.
Coming soon.
From the people who brought you nothing... comes something completely different.
Ladies and gentlemen... the main event!
Round one... fight!
Get ready. Get set. Go!
Game over? Not even close.
New high score!
Three... two... one...
One city. One summer. The streets belong to you.
Only one team will take the trophy.
Are you ready?
Welcome to the show.
Now playing, everywhere.
